lines.en: Hi Omar! Welcome to my new apartment.
Hi Sara! Thanks for inviting me. The building is nice.
Thank you! Our apartment is on the third floor.
Was it easy to find? I took the metro here.
Very easy. It is next to the bank, near the metro station.
Yes, I went straight, then turned left like you told me.
Come in! The living room has a big sofa. Sit down.
Wow, the kitchen is small but nice.
And we have a small balcony with a nice view.
How many bedrooms are there?
There are three bedrooms in the house. The bathroom is next to my bedroom.
It is a little dark in here.
Turn on the light, please. The switch is next to the door.
Much better! Are you hungry? I am starving.
Yes! Let us go shopping first. The supermarket is not far.
How long does the trip take?
Ten minutes on foot. Go straight, then turn right at the traffic light.
Okay. What do we need?
Bread, cheese, eggs, and some fruit. The bread is fresh in the morning.
How much is the cheese these days?
It is about eighty pounds a kilo. Prices are high this week.
No problem. I will pay for the fruit.
Thank you! That is very kind of you.
Do they have fresh juice there?
Yes, and a small café next door. The coffee there is excellent.
Perfect. We can drink coffee after shopping.
Good idea. I want a large cappuccino, please!
And I want black coffee with no sugar. Back to your apartment, do you like living here?
I love it. Home is the best place. And the neighbors are friendly.
That is great. Do you clean the house yourself?
Yes, I clean my room every Friday. It keeps the place fresh.
Good habit! Okay, let us go. The supermarket closes at ten.
You are right, we are late! The keys are on the table. Let me take them.
Haha, do not forget your wallet this time!
Very funny! Come on, let us go.
